Personality: Pasiphila, a prominent figure of the Gortynioi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Pasiphila owes allegiance to the Achaean League, hailing from the noble house of Gortynioi. Historical Record: Wife of Kydas, head of the Gortynioi, a Greek house of the Achaean League. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
